title: Change footer credit text to V1.0

requirements.text: In the footer text element at XPath /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/footer[1]/div[1]/div[1], replace the displayed text "Built by Hannes" with "V1.0" (English user-facing text). Apply the change wherever this same footer element is rendered (including the access-denied layout and the normal app layout) so the footer is consistent across pages.

quotes: Hey, kun je de tekst wijzigen van 'built by Hannes'  naar 'V1.0'

acceptanceCriteria: When viewing any page that shows the app footer (including the access-denied screen), the footer displays exactly: "V1.0".
The previous footer text "Built by Hannes" is no longer visible anywhere in the UI.

constraints: Apply the text change only to the selected footer text element (XPath: /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/footer[1]/div[1]/div[1]) and its equivalent rendering paths; do not alter other UI copy or layout.
nonGoals: No changes to backend logic, admin logic, authentication, or other pages/components beyond the footer text replacement.
